name: Geodoz
bio: Geodoz is the patron guardian of the Deepcast Dwarves who toil in the Pits – the endless rocky netherrealm that lies beneath Stoneloom. While Geodoz's hulking form often terrifies members of the Goldcast, its glowing red protrusions are a comforting sight to Deepcast miners. It means help is at hand, and that hand is actually an enormous hammer.
subtitle: The Pit Forged
